description: Opt-in SciPy import, bounded dense solve, and singular-matrix rejection.

arguments:
import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import solve
a = np.array([[3., 1.], [1., 2.]])
b = np.array([9., 8.])
x = solve(a, b)
assert np.allclose(a @ x, b, rtol=0, atol=1e-12)
print('solution:', x.tolist(), 'residual:', float(np.max(np.abs(a @ x - b))))
